# SG Alerts (sgalerts.com)

> Independent Singapore daily utility dashboard providing live Woodlands & Tuas checkpoint camera analysis, 3,498+ carpark & motorcycle parking rates, petrol prices & credit card calculators, COE bidding results, HDB BTO launches & mortgage calculators, 6-month T-Bill / SSB / Fixed Deposit rates, rain radar, haze/PSI, SPF speed cameras, and Singapore Pools 4D/TOTO results.

All core data is sourced from official Singapore public agencies (LTA, NEA, HDB, MAS, SPF, Singapore Pools) and fuel retailers, refreshed automatically on scheduled pipelines.

## Live Checkpoints & Cross-Border Travel
- [SG-JB Checkpoints Hub](https://sgalerts.com/travel.html): Live Woodlands & Tuas traffic cameras, AI vehicle counts, contraflow-aware direction split, and Johor rain outlook.
- [Woodlands Checkpoint](https://sgalerts.com/woodlands-checkpoint.html): Live Causeway (Cam 2701) and BKE approach (Cam 2702) cameras with AI queue density.
- [Tuas Checkpoint](https://sgalerts.com/tuas-checkpoint.html): Live Second Link (Cam 4703) and outbound Johor viaduct (Cam 4713) cameras with weekday morning and Sunday night contraflow support.
- [KTM Shuttle Tebrau Guide](https://sgalerts.com/guides/ktm-shuttle-tebrau-woodlands-jb-train.html): Woodlands CIQ to JB Sentral 5-minute train schedule, ticket tips, and booking guide.
- [Woodlands vs Tuas Checkpoint Guide](https://sgalerts.com/guides/woodlands-vs-tuas-checkpoint.html): Peak-hour comparison and crossing strategy.
- [VEP, Autopass & Touch 'n Go Checklist](https://sgalerts.com/guides/jb-causeway-vep-autopass-tng-checklist.html): Requirements for Singapore vehicles driving into Malaysia.

## Motoring, Parking, Petrol & COE
- [SG Parking Finder](https://sgalerts.com/parking.html): Interactive map and rate comparison for 3,498+ HDB, URA, and commercial mall carparks (cars and motorcycles) with live lot availability.
- [Live Singapore Petrol Prices](https://sgalerts.com/singapore-petrol-prices.html): Daily pump prices across Shell, Esso, Caltex, SPC, and Sinopec (92, 95, 98, V-Power, Diesel).
- [Petrol Credit Card Discount Calculator](https://sgalerts.com/petrol-discount-calculator.html): Nett effective price per litre after bank card rebates and loyalty discounts.
- [Latest COE Prices](https://sgalerts.com/latest-coe-prices.html): Official LTA COE bidding premiums (Cat A, B, C, D, E), quota, and PQP trends.
- [COE & Car Loan Calculator](https://sgalerts.com/coe-calculator.html): Monthly instalment, downpayment, and total depreciation estimator.
- [SPF Speed Camera Map](https://sgalerts.com/speed-cameras.html): Interactive Singapore Police Force fixed speed, red-light, mobile, and average speed camera locations.

## Savings, Housing & Everyday Utilities
- [Singapore Fixed Deposit, 6M T-Bill & SSB Rates](https://sgalerts.com/singapore-fixed-deposit-rates.html): Live MAS 6-month T-Bill cut-off yield, Singapore Savings Bonds (SSB), bank FD comparison table, and interest calculator.
- [Housing Hub (BTO & Resale)](https://sgalerts.com/housing.html): HDB BTO launch calendar, resale trends, and grants.
- [Upcoming BTO Launches](https://sgalerts.com/bto-launches.html): Estate locations, flat types, and HFE letter deadlines.
- [BTO Mortgage & MSR Calculator](https://sgalerts.com/bto-mortgage-calculator.html): HDB vs bank loan monthly repayment and 30% MSR / 55% TDSR checks.
- [SGD Currency Converter](https://sgalerts.com/sgd-currency-converter.html): Live SGD to MYR, JPY, THB, USD, EUR, GBP, and regional travel rates.
- [Singapore GST Refund Calculator](https://sgalerts.com/singapore-gst-refund-calculator.html): Tourist eTRS 9% GST refund estimator.

## Weather, Air Quality, News & Lottery
- [Singapore & Malaysia Rain Radar](https://sgalerts.com/weather/): Live NEA rain radar and 2-hour/24-hour/4-day weather outlook.
- [Singapore Haze & PSI](https://sgalerts.com/singapore/haze/): Live 24-hour PSI and 1-hour PM2.5 readings by region.
- [Singapore News](https://sgalerts.com/news.html): Curated Singapore headlines from major local outlets.
- [TOTO Results & Next Jackpot Tracker](https://sgalerts.com/toto-results.html): Latest winning numbers, next draw date, estimated jackpot, and snowball counter.
- [4D Results](https://sgalerts.com/4d-results.html): Latest 1st, 2nd, 3rd, starter, and consolation winning numbers.
